prompt: Implement semver.Compare exactly as Semantic Versioning 2.0.0 defines precedence and validity (https://semver.org): numeric identifiers must not have leading zeros, pre-release and build identifiers must be non-empty and use [0-9A-Za-z-], build metadata is ignored for precedence, and no 'v' prefix is allowed. Return an error for any invalid version. Add unit tests.
